from solution import count_Set_Bits


def test_issue_example_two():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 2 has one set bit."""
    # 2 = 0b10 -> 0+1 = 1
    assert count_Set_Bits(2) == 1


def test_issue_zero():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 0 has no set bits."""
    # 0 = 0b0 -> 0
    assert count_Set_Bits(0) == 0


def test_issue_one():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 1 has one set bit."""
    # 1 = 0b1 -> 1
    assert count_Set_Bits(1) == 1


def test_issue_three():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 3 has two set bits."""
    # 3 = 0b11 -> 1+1 = 2
    assert count_Set_Bits(3) == 2


def test_issue_seven():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 7 has three set bits."""
    # 7 = 0b111 -> 1+1+1 = 3
    assert count_Set_Bits(7) == 3


def test_issue_eight_boundary():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 8 has one set bit."""
    # 8 = 0b1000 -> 1+0+0+0 = 1
    assert count_Set_Bits(8) == 1


def test_issue_seven_to_eight_transition():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 9 just above 8 has two set bits."""
    # 9 = 0b1001 -> 1+0+0+1 = 2
    assert count_Set_Bits(9) == 2


def test_issue_all_low_bits_fifteen():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 15 has four set bits."""
    # 15 = 0b1111 -> 1+1+1+1 = 4
    assert count_Set_Bits(15) == 4


def test_contract_power_of_two_sixteen():
    """Count set bits of a given number: power of two has one set bit."""
    # 16 = 0b10000 -> 1+0+0+0+0 = 1
    assert count_Set_Bits(16) == 1


def test_contract_mixed_bits_ten():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 10 has two set bits."""
    # 10 = 0b1010 -> 1+0+1+0 = 2
    assert count_Set_Bits(10) == 2


def test_contract_all_low_bits_255():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 255 has eight set bits."""
    # 255 = 0b11111111 -> 1+1+1+1+1+1+1+1 = 8
    assert count_Set_Bits(255) == 8


def test_contract_large_power_of_two():
    """Count set bits of a given number: 1024 has one set bit."""
    # 1024 = 0b10000000000 -> 1+0*10 = 1
    assert count_Set_Bits(1024) == 1
